{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:53.653996Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:53.653782Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:54.472231Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:54.471450Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:54.474836Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:54.474623Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.576658Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.575443Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.578332Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.578054Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.584607Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.583872Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.586212Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.585706Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.603457Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.602708Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.987\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.986\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     1174.\n",
      "Date:                Fri, 27 Nov 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           1.90e-43\n",
      "Time:                        21:14:57   Log-Likelihood:                 7.4880\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                            -6.976\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                            0.6720\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          5.1332      0.074     69.344      0.000       4.984       5.282\n",
      "x1             0.4844      0.011     42.425      0.000       0.461       0.507\n",
      "x2             0.5472      0.045     12.192      0.000       0.457       0.637\n",
      "x3            -0.0186      0.001    -18.558      0.000      -0.021      -0.017\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        0.030   Durbin-Watson:                   1.964\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.985   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.206\n",
      "Skew:                           0.021   Prob(JB):                        0.902\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.689   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.604929Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.604700Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.613749Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.612898Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.66815065  5.1558548   5.6016787   5.97580286  6.25916951  6.44661368\n",
      "  6.54771186  6.58520854  6.5912794   6.60224494  6.65260308  6.76936131\n",
      "  6.96759937  7.24799174  7.59669683  7.98763107  8.3867544   8.75766294\n",
      "  9.06757006  9.29269312  9.42216088  9.45979965  9.4235046   9.34229964\n",
      "  9.25156889  9.18724318  9.17989666  9.24972362  9.40322059  9.63211898\n",
      "  9.91474359 10.21957381 10.51042229 10.75238053 10.91755415 10.98964591\n",
      " 10.96663329 10.86110077 10.69817226 10.51138329 10.33717124 10.20888876\n",
      " 10.15132402 10.17662812 10.28231866 10.45168761 10.6565464  10.86185718\n",
      " 11.03148951 11.13415642]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.615070Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.614889Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.626030Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.625717Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[11.13853813 11.00008046 10.74024077 10.40791767 10.06747894  9.78300205\n",
      "  9.60258574  9.5465738   9.60257421  9.72849309]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.633716Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:57.633568Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.068885Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.065772Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x735ca42841a0>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.071555Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.071390Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.089147Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.085740Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.091494Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.091344Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.102186Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.100762Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           5.133220\n",
       "x1                  0.484352\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.547155\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.018603\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.104624Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.104481Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.123188Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-27T21:14:58.118755Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    11.138538\n",
       "1    11.000080\n",
       "2    10.740241\n",
       "3    10.407918\n",
       "4    10.067479\n",
       "5     9.783002\n",
       "6     9.602586\n",
       "7     9.546574\n",
       "8     9.602574\n",
       "9     9.728493\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
